_readme: Draft scroll content for the 19 wisdom_library categories that exist as onboarding interests but have no Firestore doc. Doc IDs match _pickWisdomCategory's mapping in sanctuary_screen.dart: lowercase, ' & ' -> '_', spaces -> '_', hyphens KEPT. Review/edit freely, then upload with tool/upload_wisdom_library.mjs. Tone matches the existing 5 docs: second person, celestial metaphor, strong opening line (free users only see the first lines before the paywall blur), ~300-520 chars per scroll, 2 scrolls per category.
emotional_wellness: Your feelings are weather, not climate. Storms of sadness, fronts of anger, fogs of doubt — they pass across your inner sky without changing what that sky is. You do not have to fix a feeling to survive it; you only have to let it move through. Today, name what you feel without apologizing for it. The naming itself is the clearing.

There is a stillness in you older than any wound. Beneath the churn of the day's emotions sits an observer — calm, unhurried, undamaged — watching the tides come and go. Visit that observer today. You are not required to be okay every hour to be whole. Wholeness is the orbit that holds all of your weathers, bright and dark, and keeps circling anyway. Nothing you feel today is too heavy for the gravity that carries you.
pet_lovers: The creature who waits for you does not know what a deadline is. To them you are not behind, not failing, not unfinished — you are simply the whole sky. Let their uncomplicated devotion recalibrate you today: eat when hungry, rest without guilt, greet the ones you love like it's been years. The animals mastered presence long before we named it.

Every evening, somewhere in your home, a small heart syncs its rhythm to yours. Science calls it co-regulation; the cosmos calls it companionship. Your habits are not only yours — the walk you keep, the routine you honor, the calm you cultivate ripples into a life that trusts you completely. Show up for your rituals the way they show up for you: every single time, tail high, no questions asked.
structure_organisation: Orbits are not cages — they are freedom with a shape. The planets do not resent their paths; the path is what keeps them from drifting into the dark. The structure you build today is not a wall around your life but a rail to lean on when willpower runs thin. Order one small corner of your world and watch the calm radiate outward.

Chaos is expensive. Every misplaced thing, every undecided hour, every open loop quietly taxes the same energy you need for what matters. Structure is how you stop paying that tax. Tonight, choose tomorrow's first move before you sleep — one decision made in calm is worth ten made in a hurry. The stars keep their courses not by effort but by arrangement. Arrange, and the effort halves itself.
reading_studying: A page a day is a library in a decade. Knowledge does not arrive like a comet — it accumulates like stardust, invisibly, until one day you notice you are made of different material. Read today not to finish, but to feed. The mind, like a telescope, sees further the longer it stays fixed on the light.

Every book is a transmission from another mind, sometimes across centuries — the closest thing to telepathy this universe permits. When you study, you are not memorizing; you are wiring new constellations between neurons that will fire for the rest of your life. Ten focused minutes outweigh two distracted hours. Close the other tabs, silence the noise, and let one idea land completely. Depth, not speed, is how galaxies form.
the_environment: You are not on the Earth; you are of it. The iron in your blood was forged in dying stars, the water in your body has cycled through oceans and clouds for four billion years. Caring for this planet is not charity — it is self-maintenance on the grandest scale. One mindful choice today is a signal flare: this world has crew, not passengers.

The Earth keeps every promise it has ever made: seeds become forests, rivers reach the sea, seasons return without fail. Match that reliability in your own small orbit. Reuse the thing. Take the walk instead of the drive. Choose once well instead of thrice cheaply. No single raindrop believes it is responsible for the flood — but no single raindrop is innocent of it either. Your habits are votes for the world you want to orbit.
mindful_eating: Every meal is a message to your body about what kind of life it should prepare for. Eat in a hurry and it braces for famine and flight; eat with attention and it settles into growth and repair. Today, taste the first three bites completely — no screen, no scroll. Nourishment begins where distraction ends.

You are the current custodian of a body assembled from sunlight — every calorie you eat was once starlight, captured by a leaf, passed up the chain to you. Honor the supply line. Hunger is information, not emergency; fullness is a whisper, not a shout, and you only hear it when you slow down enough to listen. Put the fork down between bites tonight. The meal is not a pit stop. It is one of the few times a day the cosmos literally becomes you.
self-discipline: Discipline is remembering what you want most over what you want now. It is not punishment — it is loyalty to your future self, the one who inherits every choice you make today. The rocket does not negotiate with gravity each morning; it simply burns in the committed direction. Choose your direction once, then let repetition do the lifting.

Motivation is weather; discipline is climate. The version of you that shows up on the gray, unwilling days is the one who actually builds the life — anyone can orbit on a clear night. So lower the bar until you cannot say no: two minutes, one page, a single rep. The habit kept small and unbroken beats the heroic effort abandoned by Thursday. You are not grinding. You are compounding. There is a difference, and in a year it will be visible from space.
behavior_change: You do not rise to the level of your intentions; you fall to the level of your systems. The person you are becoming is being cast, vote by vote, by what you repeat — not what you plan. Change the cue, shrink the step, celebrate the rep. Identity is just habit with a long memory.

Every habit you have ever built began as a single awkward repetition that felt like a costume. Then one day the costume became skin. This is the quiet magic of behavior: the brain rebuilds itself around whatever you insist on, roughly two hundred times. So insist. Miss a day? The data says one lapse changes nothing — only the story you tell about the lapse does. You are not starting over. You are mid-flight, adjusting course, exactly as every successful mission always has.
gratitude: Gratitude is gravity for joy — without it, every good thing drifts past uncaptured. The sunrise you ignored this morning was a one-time cosmic event that will never repeat in exactly that light again. Tonight, name three things that went un-thanked today. Watch how quickly abundance appears once you start keeping records of it.

You are living inside an answered prayer — someone, at some point, wished desperately for much of what you now call ordinary. The warm bed. The working body. The person who texts back. Gratitude does not deny what is hard; it simply refuses to let the hard erase the whole ledger. The universe has been assembling this exact moment for 13.8 billion years. The least we can do is notice it arrived. Say thank you to one person today, specifically, and out loud.
aging: You are not getting older; you are getting layered. Every year adds a ring of proof — storms survived, droughts outlasted, seasons of absurd growth. The stars we admire most are the ancient ones, still burning after everything. Tend the body you have today with the respect owed to a vessel that has carried you this far without once taking a day off.

Time is not stealing from you; it is editing you — cutting the noise, keeping the signal. What remains after the years do their work is more you, not less: fewer performances, deeper certainties, a shorter list of things worth worrying about. Move your body today like an heirloom, not a rental. Stretch what stiffens, walk what aches, rest what asks. The goal was never to stay young. It was to stay lit — and old light travels furthest.
financial_habits: Money is stored energy — hours of your one finite life, crystallized. Spend it like you are spending time, because you are. The small leak sinks the great ship: today, find one recurring drain you no longer value and seal it. Wealth is not built in the windfall. It is built in the Tuesday decisions no one applauds.

Compound interest is the closest thing to orbital mechanics your money will ever know: small, boring, repeated inputs bending into an unstoppable curve. The first years always feel like nothing is happening — that is the flat part of every exponential story ever told. Automate the saving so your discipline doesn't have to win a daily debate. Future-you is real, is coming, and will either inherit your foresight or your excuses. Fund the first one.
self-love: Speak to yourself today the way you would speak to someone you were responsible for protecting — because you are. The voice in your head is the room you live in; furnish it kindly. You have apologized for your existence in a hundred small ways this week. Retract one of them today. Take up your space. It was issued to you at birth.

You are the only witness to every battle you have ever fought — the ones no one applauded, the mornings you rose anyway, the kindnesses you performed unseen. Let the record show you have been braver than advertised. Self-love is not a mirror-mantra; it is logistics: the early night, the boundary held, the meal that was a decision and not an accident. Care for yourself with the same seriousness you offer everyone else. You are not the exception to your own compassion.
parenthood: You are the constellation they navigate by — not because you are perfect, but because you are constant. They will not remember most of what you said today; they will remember the climate of you. Warm front or cold, calm or storm. Repair beats perfection every time: the apology you model is worth a hundred lectures.

Right now you are building the voice that will live inside their head at thirty — the one that speaks when they fail, when they try, when they look in the mirror. Make it a kind voice. This season that feels endless is, by cosmic accounting, a single rotation: eighteen summers, a handful of first days, one long blink. You will not do it flawlessly, and that was never the assignment. The assignment is presence. Sit on the floor tonight. The laundry orbits back; the moment does not.
better_relationships: Every relationship is a shared orbit — drift is the default, and closeness is a correction you make on purpose. The people you love are not mind readers on retainer; say the appreciation out loud, ask the question underneath the question, put the phone in another room. Attention is the rarest currency you hold. Spend it on purpose today.

The strongest bonds in the universe are not the ones without friction — they are the ones that survive re-entry, again and again. Rupture and repair: that is the whole physics of human closeness. Today, go first. First to apologize, first to be curious instead of right, first to name the thing everyone is orbiting around. Being fully known and loved anyway is the nearest thing to home this cosmos offers. It is built one honest, slightly terrifying sentence at a time.
physical_wellness: Your body is the only spacecraft you will ever be issued, and it repairs itself nightly if you let it. Movement is not a punishment for what you ate; it is a celebration of what you can still do. Today, move for ten minutes in any direction. The vessel maintains its captain exactly as well as the captain maintains the vessel.

Fifty trillion cells are working the night shift for you at this very moment — hauling oxygen, patching walls, defending borders — asking only for sleep, water, movement, and reasonable fuel. That is the entire invoice. Strength is not built in the heroic workout but in the unremarkable ones you refused to skip. Walk today. Stretch what complains. Lift something. Your future body is eavesdropping on every choice, taking notes, and building itself accordingly.
detox_bad_habits: You are not breaking a habit; you are starving an orbit. Every craving is a satellite you launched long ago, still circling, still beeping — but its signal weakens every single time you decline to answer. The urge peaks, crests, and passes in minutes. Outlast one wave today. That is the entire war, fought one wave at a time.

The habit was never the problem — it was your solution to a problem, just an expensive one. Boredom, stress, loneliness: the bill arrives and the old vice offers to pay in counterfeit. Your work is not white-knuckled refusal forever; it is finding the honest currency. Replace, don't just remove. Fill the vacated orbit with something that actually orbits back. Relapse is data, not identity. The person who slips on day forty is forty days stronger than the one who never began.
purpose_motivation: Purpose is not found like a lost object; it is built like a fire — kindled from what you already carry, fed daily, tended especially when it dims. Stop waiting for the grand calling. Do the nearest good thing well and the path lights itself, one footstep of visibility at a time. Direction reveals itself only to those in motion.

The universe spent 13.8 billion years arranging atoms into someone who can ask what their life is for — you are matter interrogating its own meaning, and that alone is astonishing. But meaning is a verb wearing a noun's disguise. It shows up in the doing: the craft honed, the person helped, the promise kept when no one is watching. Motivation will abandon you regularly; mission does not. Know the difference. Tie your habits to the mission, and the missing motivation stops mattering.
better_sleep: Sleep is not the absence of living — it is the maintenance of the one who lives. Every night, your mind files the day, rinses its own machinery, and rehearses tomorrow's strength. Guard the final hour before bed like a launch protocol: dim the world, cool the room, land the screens. The day ends better when the landing is flown on purpose.

Half the galaxy is only visible in the dark, and half of who you are is only built while you sleep — memory, repair, patience, the mood you will wear tomorrow. You cannot hustle your way out of a debt your body keeps in exact ledgers. Tonight, trade the last scroll for the first page of a book. Keep the wake time steady and the room like a cave: cool, dark, quiet. Rest is not the reward for finishing everything. It is the requirement for finishing anything.
balanced_life: Balance is not standing still — even the galaxy holds itself together by spinning. Some seasons tilt toward work, some toward rest, some toward people who need you. The art is not equal portions every day; it is honest correction over time. Tonight, ask the only audit question that matters: what have I been orbiting lately — and did I choose it?

A life leaning entirely toward one gravity eventually falls into it — brilliant careers orbiting burnout, full calendars orbiting empty rooms. You are a system of many bodies: the worker, the friend, the body itself, the quiet self that only appears when nothing is scheduled. Each needs its share of your sky. Say no to one good thing this week to protect a better one. Balance is not something you find. It is something you keep choosing, wobble by wobble, like every star that ever held its planets.
